summary: Doc 34 (Platform Reliability, Performance & Scalability MVP) fully tested — backend 11/11 pytest pass and frontend E2E pass. Backend: GET /api/hi/jobs returns {jobs, active}; bogus job → 404. Async design concept E2E on new project (TEST_reading_nook, room_refresh): POST /concept returns {job_id, status:queued, message} → polling shows job progresses through running + waiting_provider with progress > 0 → ends completed with progress=100 → version 1 with image_available=true persisted. Refine {instruction:'warmer colors'} same async flow → version 2 completed. Cancel on completed job → 409. AI cost protection: set ai_daily_per_user=1 → 1st Homie chat message via /api/hi/chat/conversations/{cid}/message passes, 2nd returns 429 with 'limit ... reset tomorrow' message. Kill switch on → 503 with 'briefly paused for maintenance'. Limits reset to 300/kill_switch=false + rl_ai_calls cleared for demo today (verified). System status returns overall='ok' + 6 tiered services each with key/label/tier/status. Admin reliability: /admin/reliability/jobs (queue_depth, by_status, by_type, recent_failures), /costs (total, by_feature, by_provider), /limits GET+PUT roundtrip persists; all three 403 for demo user. Frontend on 390x844: logged in as demo_home, opened a fresh design project via API → tapped dsd-generate → dsd-job-progress card appeared with 'Homie is designing your concept…' + progress bar advancing 5%→sketching→rendering → concept image (Cozy Reading Nook, sofa+bookshelves) renders and progress card disappears. /home-intel/account → account-activity row navigates to /home-intel/activity which lists prior test jobs with 'Done' status chips (Design concept + Design refinement). /home-intel dashboard renders (banner hidden), /home-intel/start Ask Homie input & first-project card render. CLEANUP verified: no TEST_ ds_projects remain, rl_ai_calls demo/today=0, limits back to 300/false.
critical_code_review_comments: reliability_engine.enforce_ai_budget uses find_one_and_update with $inc + $setOnInsert and post-increment check (count > cap) — correct: with cap=1 first call sets count=1 (not >1 so passes), second call sets count=2 (raises 429). Behavior matches spec.

run_job() runs work in asyncio.create_task with ONE automatic retry (attempt 0 then attempt 1); on retry sets status='retrying' with friendly 'Taking longer than usual' message. Cancellation is checked at top of each attempt (job.status=='canceled' → return).
design_studio_engine.generate_concept + refine correctly call enforce_ai_budget BEFORE creating the job, so a rate-limited user gets 429 immediately without leaving orphan queued jobs.

System status _system_status() aggregates 5xx error_events from the last 15 min ONLY (4xx like the intentional 429/403 do NOT degrade overall) — matches spec; overall remained 'ok' throughout tests even after 429 + 503 responses.
reliability_engine.build_admin_router uses require_admin dependency which returns 403 for demo user — confirmed via test_admin_endpoints_forbidden_for_demo.

activity.tsx correctly polls /hi/jobs every 4s while there are active jobs and stops the timer when active=0 (prevents infinite polling). Uses testID='account-activity', 'dsd-job-progress' as expected.
One minor observation: design/[id].tsx client-side polls /hi/jobs/{id} every 2.5s for up to 180s — no server-side backpressure, but the job endpoints are lightweight lookups. Acceptable for MVP.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Doc 34 is fully green. Reliability engine (rl_jobs, rl_settings, rl_ai_calls collections) is production-shape. Design Studio concept generation is REAL Gemini image generation (~15-20s per job in tests). If future tests need to trigger rate-limit paths, use the Homie chat message endpoint /api/hi/chat/conversations/{cid}/message (not /hi/chat/homie which does not exist).
